estimate: F_acc = m_est f_z + D_model (sim6 k_est_asc 2 model on the estimated vz), 0.1 N steps, 100 Hz frames

variants.raw: 1 kHz sample at the frame instant
variants.box10ms: mean of the 10 samples of the frame
variants.tau10ms: first-order low-pass tau 10 ms at 1 kHz
variants.tau20ms: first-order low-pass tau 20 ms at 1 kHz

windows.air: h_est > 1 m after liftoff until touchdown, any engine state (v1)
windows.fc: air AND engine lit (ECU RUN) AND drogue not attached (GNC proposal for the FC_THRUST valid flag)
windows.error_statistics: fc frames with true thrust > 0.15 F_max, after the first 0.1 s of each fc window segment (filter settling); held maxima and false aborts use every fc frame

hold.rule: abort if F_acc > T on 3 consecutive frames (20 ms span)

k_hat_check_sim.note: sim6 k_hat (tau 0.1 s) / ((1 + m_est_err) thrust_scale (1 + a_sf)): ~1 confirms the error model
sim6 k_hat (tau 0.1 s) / ((1 + m_est_err) thrust_scale (1 + a_sf)): ~1 confirms the error model
sim6 k_hat (tau 0.1 s) / ((1 + m_est_err) thrust_scale (1 + a_sf)): ~1 confirms the error model
sim6 k_hat (tau 0.1 s) / ((1 + m_est_err) thrust_scale (1 + a_sf)): ~1 confirms the error model

error_decomposition.note: rest = (1 + e) / (1 + m_est_err) - 1: scale factor, bias, vibration and white noise after the filter, drag-model error, gimbal cosine, rotation terms. Steady-state Gaussian per frame; the per-flight bias is the mass error plus the scale factor

threshold_sweep_fc.note: false abort at T <=> per-run held maximum (fc window) > T; 'gauss' = normal fit of the per-run held maxima (extrapolation, model-dependent in the tail)

stuck_pintle_detection.note: synthetic ramp through each healthy run's bias factor (1 + m_est_err)(1 + a_sf), accelerometer bias and noise at that thrust; random frame phase; detection = held 20 ms above T; miss = no detection within 2 s; alarm_before_failure = above T at F0

latency_note: estimate latency at the FC output = filter delay (step 50 % / 90 %, ramp lag) + frame staleness 0-9 ms (the ECU holds the last frame); NOT included: IMU internal digital filter and sample delay (part not chosen: DATASHEET needed), FC task scheduling, CAN transport and ECU scheduling (Electronics), airframe axial dynamics between the engine and the IMU (rigid body in sim6)

gaussian_extrapolation_tau20ms.model: relative error at F >= 450 N ~ N(mean, sd) of the pooled healthy frames (bias + noise per frame; the held 20 ms rule removes most of the noise, so this overstates the noise part); steady thrust at the named level
